sources.name: UAV-SEAD
sources.decision_reason: License, immutable revision, provenance, privacy, and the five-file sampled pilot checks pass. Source-wide integrity, schema, duplicates, label-fitness, leakage, and training-approval reviews remain incomplete.

license_audit.finding: Dataset card and repository metadata declare CC BY 4.0. The public API reported gated=false at immutable revision 774a336a1d1d06b248927a35c2ea1f6869e9e1a4. Canonical legal text SHA-256: 9ba9550ad48438d0836ddab3da480b3b69ffa0aac7b7878b5a0039e7ab429411.

sources.provenance: Author repository aykutkabaoglu/uav-flight-anomaly-dataset, DOI 10.57967/hf/7772, frozen revision 774a336a1d1d06b248927a35c2ea1f6869e9e1a4.

sources.name: UAV-SEAD AeroVane reviewed corpus v1
sources.decision_reason: Approval is restricted to the 155 payload hashes frozen by cumulative inventory SHA-256 b31c3513415e85b4601cc33db5867bcf8121ba22d1f25e96c8c5dee2f75e007f. All acquired payloads passed size/checksum inventory, canonical schema, privacy, interval, and cross-corpus duplicate checks. Six unknown flights and every related group are excluded. This does not approve unacquired UAV-SEAD files.

license_audit.finding: The reviewed corpus contains only hash-frozen files from immutable upstream revision 774a336a1d1d06b248927a35c2ea1f6869e9e1a4 under the source's declared CC BY 4.0 license.

sources.provenance: Hash-defined 155-flight subset of author repository aykutkabaoglu/uav-flight-anomaly-dataset at revision 774a336a1d1d06b248927a35c2ea1f6869e9e1a4; cumulative inventory SHA-256 b31c3513415e85b4601cc33db5867bcf8121ba22d1f25e96c8c5dee2f75e007f.

sources.name: UAV-FD actuator fault dataset v1
sources.decision_reason: Approval is restricted to the 18 official MATLAB flight files whose MD5 checksums match Zenodo record 7648996. The files contain real hexarotor flights with normal and deliberately chipped-propeller conditions. The source has no location fields in the admitted feature path, and the training adapter reads only IMU, vibration, attitude, and ESC measurements.

license_audit.finding: The official immutable Zenodo record declares open access and CC BY 4.0. Every admitted raw flight matches the publisher-provided MD5.

sources.provenance: Zenodo record 7648996, version v1, published 2023-02-26; 18 checksum-bound real-flight MATLAB files.

sources.name: AirLab Failure and Anomaly dataset (ALFA)
sources.decision_reason: Explicit dataset usage terms must be archived and confirmed commercially compatible before any files are admitted.

license_audit.finding: Official repository requests citation and provides downloads but exposes no dataset license grant. Repository publicity and citation instructions are not permission for commercial training.

sources.provenance: Publisher repository and paper; release version not yet frozen.

sources.name: RflyMAD
sources.decision_reason: Published non-commercial restriction conflicts with AeroVane commercial compatibility; reconsider only with compatible written permission.

license_audit.finding: Official dataset page limits the dataset and related work to non-commercial situations and directs commercial users to contact the rights holder.

sources.name: PX4 public Flight Review logs
sources.decision_reason: Each public record needs a stable license/provenance record and privacy review before a sample is acquired.

license_audit.finding: Official PX4 documentation permits public Flight Review logs for machine learning and labels them CC-BY PX4. The page does not identify a Creative Commons version or complete attribution wording, so the license check remains open.

sources.provenance: Public Flight Review service; no individual records selected.

sources.name: ArduPilot AutoTest history
sources.decision_reason: Useful parser/regression corpus, pending a frozen build, artifact provenance, output licensing, privacy, integrity, and duplicate checks.

license_audit.finding: Official pages publish generated logs and describe their production, but no explicit license for AutoTest output was located. ArduPilot source-code licensing alone does not settle log-data rights.

sources.provenance: ArduPilot automated build service; build not yet selected.

sources.name: AeroVane-generated ArduPilot/PX4 SITL scenarios
sources.decision_reason: Concept approved, but generated logs are not admissible until simulator commits, scenarios, seeds, environment, licensing, and checksums are frozen in Phase D.

license_audit.finding: AeroVane may license its own scenario definitions and generated factual telemetry, but each run must record simulator/source licenses and third-party assets. Approval waits for those pinned inputs.

sources.citation: Generated by AeroVane; simulator dependencies must be cited per run.

sources.name: Consented AeroVane user logs
sources.decision_reason: No collection is permitted until an explicit opt-in consent and deletion workflow is implemented and approved.

license_audit.finding: No blanket license can cover future user logs. Each contribution needs an explicit consent/license grant covering the intended training, evaluation, retention, and model distribution uses.

sources.provenance: Future opt-in collection; no files collected.
